title: Reminder: Lobsters NYC Meetup Tomorrow 5:30 at Walker's
content_html:
Follow up on: https://lobste.rs/s/73ozwc/lobsters_nyc_meetup_on_28th_october

Under "Alex". Feel free to come a bit later or earlier. I'll write here updating if we move etc.

Walker's is by the Canal St. metro stop: https://maps.app.goo.gl/mdEgSkBV2H1NSXAdA and has food and drinks.
